reviews.author: Cheri R…
reviews.body: I was in the area for a work trip and was recommended by a colleague to call Jessie for a much needed gel manicure and I’m certainly glad I did.  She fit me in right away and did an excellent job. I was so impressed how clean & thorough she was.  It’s a shame I can’t get my nails done by her all the time, however I know who to call when I’m in the area!!
